label: Chemistry
description: Edexcel IAL Chemistry

label: Unit 1: Structure, Bonding and Introduction to Organic Chemistry
description: WCH11 — IAL Chemistry Unit 1

label: Formulae, Equations and Amount of Substance
description: Chemical formulae, equations, the mole, reacting masses and volumes, empirical/molecular formulae.

label: Mole calculations and reacting masses
description: The mole as the SI unit of amount; molar mass; reacting mass calculations; percentage yield.

label: Empirical and molecular formulae
description: Determination of empirical formulae from composition data; scaling to molecular formulae.

label: Atomic Structure and the Periodic Table
description: Subatomic particles, isotopes, electronic configuration, ionisation energies and periodic trends.

label: Atomic structure, isotopes and ions
description: Protons, neutrons, electrons; mass number and isotopes; formation of ions; relative atomic mass.

label: Electron configuration and periodic trends
description: Electron shells, sub-shells and orbitals; successive ionisation energies; periodicity.

label: Bonding and Structure
description: Ionic, covalent and metallic bonding; molecular shape; intermolecular forces and structure.

label: Ionic bonding and lattice structure
description: Formation of ions; ionic lattice structure; physical properties of ionic compounds.

label: Covalent bonding, shapes and intermolecular forces
description: Single/double covalent bonds, dative bonds; VSEPR shapes; polarity; van der Waals and hydrogen bonding.

label: Moles and grams are interchangeable
description: Treating a mass in grams as a number of moles, or assuming one mole of any substance weighs 1 g.

label: Ionic compounds form discrete molecule pairs
description: Believing solid NaCl consists of NaCl "molecules" (one Na+ per one Cl-) rather than a giant lattice.

label: The octet rule is an absolute law
description: Assuming atoms always react to complete their outer electron shells, with no exceptions (e.g. BF3, NO).

label: Isotopes of the same element differ chemically
description: Confusing mass differences of isotopes with chemical behaviour differences; isotopes react identically.
